hooks.text: 重掷、复制、拆分、翻面并附魔法力骰，把运气改造成战术资源
hooks.excerpt: Control the fickle Mana Dice by rerolling, duplicating, splitting, flipping, and enchanting them with special effects. Bend luck to your will and unleash devastating magic!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 敌人会感染、点燃法术或诅咒骰面，直接破坏你的施法计划
hooks.excerpt: Engage in battles with enemies directly disrupting your spells and dice : 🍄 Twisted mushrooms infect your spells with spreading debuffs. 🔥 Fiery elementals ignite your spells, making them dangerous to cast. 💀 Cursed Voidbringers doom your Dice to roll poorly and destabilizes spells.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 从350多种法术中选牌组合，穿越70余场独立战斗
hooks.excerpt: Draft from over 350 powerful spells to assemble the perfect combination and crush your enemies in 70+ unique encounters.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
